rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and policyholder injury from the accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday; vehicle is totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on police report. High-severity claim requiring prompt vehicle assessment and injury documentation.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other driver traveling ~35 mph, no braking, trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.third_party_info: Other driver's insurance info on police report
